text:
nora: Quick catch-up on Zephyrus14b bring-up. Ran fp16, int8 and an experimental int4-lite path. Strong cost upside but some quality hits on multi-turn summarization and chain-of-thought.
samir: numbers please.
nora: p50: fp16 210ms -> int8 170ms -> int4 140ms. p95: fp16 760 -> int8 790 -> int4 880. cost/1M tokens: fp16 ~$210 -> int8 ~$158 -> int4 ~$112 (est). Multi-turn summary ROUGE-L: fp16 61.7 -> int8 58.9 -> int4 53.2 (sample 3k).
kai: int4 looks aggressive. Any human evals on hallucination or instruction-following?
nora: human spot (400 samples) shows acceptable answers: fp16 84% -> int8 78% -> int4 65%. Hallucination rate up notably in int4 (fp16 4% -> int4 13%).
leah: Product will push back on int4 for customer-facing assistants. We should propose conservative defaults.
samir: Mitigations? hybrid routing, confidence gating, or selective precision by layer. Also consider prefix-caching + post-hoc verifier.
nora: Did a quick selective-precision test: keep attention + final MLP fp16, rest int4-like quant. That recovered ~60% of the int4 ROUGE loss with ~10% extra cost over pure int4. Latency similar to int4.
kai: Nice. Could be a good middle ground. What about a verifier step? cheap verifier adds cost but catches hallucinations.
leah: For GTN we should recommend a two-tier default: conservative endpoints (assistants, code, summarization) => hybrid-int route with 30% fp16 fallback; best-effort endpoints (search snippets, casual chat) => int8 default. Int4 experimental only behind canary+explicit signoff.
samir: Unit econ sketch: assume 150k d queries, avg 1.5k tokens. fp16 baseline ~$47.25k/day, int8 ~$35.55k/day, int4 ~$25.2k/day. Hybrid 30% fp16 blend -> ~$39.9k/day (saves ~15% vs fp16). Selective-precision (attention+final MLP fp16) cost ~27.8k/day (savings ~41% vs fp16) with quality near int8.
nora: Canary plan: 5% int4-only early canary, paired A/B with 95% fp16. If hallucination_rate > 5pp OR ROUGE-L drop > 2.0 absolute on the sampled slice -> rollback. Then staged: enable selective-precision config for 15% traffic and measure.
kai: Example eval commands I ran: ```bash
ri eval run --model zephyrus14b-int8 --suite multi-turn-summary --samples 3000 --kv-cache warm --out results/zephyrus_int8_summary.json
ri eval run --model zephyrus14b-int4-lite --suite multi-turn-summary --samples 3000 --kv-cache warm --out results/zephyrus_int4_summary.json
ri eval run --model zephyrus14b-selective --suite multi-turn-summary --samples 1500 --kv-cache warm --out results/zephyrus_selective.json
```
leah: Please drop artifacts to drive and add a short human-notes.md. I'll draft the GTN blurb with recommended defaults and rollback thresholds.
samir: Infra note: int4 kernels on older clusters may be slower than H100 optimized builds. Need per-cluster perf profile before any GA.
nora: Agreed. Also file a small task to add per-region performance + quality profile in model catalog.
deploy-bot: Canary scheduled: zephyrus14b-int4-canary will be created by samir on 2026-05-05T13:00:00Z.
leah: Owners: nora -> finish selective-precision grid (int4 knobs + layers) and upload artifacts; samir -> create canary + alerts (hallucination_rate, ROUGE-L delta, p95 latency); kai -> run significance bootstrap and cost sims; leah -> GTN blurb and thresholds. Timeline: selective grid by EOD Tues, canary next week.
nora: Will post progress. Thanks team :thumbsup:
